phase_name: Replace the no-op CSL-type filter with an authoritative itemType filter

objectives.description: Per-window raw format=json fetch to a temp file
Filter csljson page by key against raw itemType exclusion set
Route raw-fetch/parse failures to loud-abort path
Do not use unverified server-side itemType query param
Comment recording why CSL .type cannot carry this filter

deviations.description: Curl stub extension for per-format fail/malformed knobs (RAW_FAIL_AT/RAW_MALFORMED_AT)
deviations.reason: Plan's Phase 3 verification requires 'raw fetch stubbed to fail -> exits non-zero, writes nothing' as a distinct case from a general page failure. The Phase 1 FAIL_AT/MALFORMED_AT knobs apply to both formats at a given start and collide with the no-start probe defaulting to start=0, so dedicated format=json-only knobs were added to curl-stub.sh (not originally itemized in Phase 1's task list) to make this specific case testable without also tripping the initial API probe.
deviations.annotation: *(deviation: altered — added RAW_FAIL_AT/RAW_MALFORMED_AT stub knobs, not in original Phase 1 task list)*
